methodology_explanation: The estimate combines keyword-based sizing with qualitative top-down and bottom-up validation. SAM uses the 74,000 monthly beachhead searches, a conservative 0.05%-0.08% search-to-customer conversion, and the lower pricing-anchor value of $15-$20 per month ($180-$240 annually): 74,000 × 0.05%-0.08% × $180-$240 = approximately $0.08-$0.17M. TAM uses the conservative 855,980 monthly-search topic-cluster ceiling as the follow-on reach proxy: 855,980 × 0.05%-0.08% × $180-$240 = approximately $0.92-$1.97M; SOM applies 0.5%-2% of SAM in Year 1 and 5%-10% in Year 3. The solution is serviceable to 8 of the 21 validated pains, a subset of the niche, so SAM and SOM confidence is Moderate-to-Low; the 1,419-2,559 monthly organic traffic ceiling also indicates that the higher SOM range requires non-content channels such as data-product licensing, API access, partnerships, and referral revenue rather than SEO monetization alone.
data_sources_used: Beachhead keyword demand: 74,000 monthly searches for green coffee
Broader keyword demand: 904,800 monthly searches across the supplied keyword universe
Conservative follow-on reach proxy: 855,980 monthly searches across five topic clusters; the raw 904,800 total was not used as the ceiling because keyword overlap is possible
Pricing anchor: $15-$40 per month estimated advertising revenue and approximately $20 per month affiliate revenue; the conservative $15-$20 per month range was used
Commercial intent ratio: 68%, including 218,940 commercial-intent searches per month
Pain-point frequency: 91 niche-wide mentions across 21 validated pains, with 8 pains in scope and 3 high-severity pains
Competitive landscape: 6 identified competitors and incumbent products
SEO difficulty-weighted organic traffic ceiling: 1,419-2,559 visits per month in Year 1 and 1,525-2,840 visits per month in Year 3
No industry report or historical keyword trend data was provided; therefore, no external top-down market figure or CAGR was substituted

segment_sizing.segment_name: Coffee-specific safety hazards, supplier-risk intelligence, and roastery practices
segment_sizing.sizing_methodology: Hybrid: the 855,980 monthly-search five-cluster universe is used as the conservative follow-on TAM ceiling, while the 74,000 monthly green-coffee beachhead demand anchors SAM; SOM is calculated as 0.5%-2% of SAM in Year 1 and 5%-10% in Year 3.

growth_drivers: Strong commercial intent, with a 68% commercial-intent ratio and 218,940 commercial searches per month
Increasing need for defensible supplier and import-risk verification independent of importer marketing claims
Availability of structured FDA Import Refusal Reports and EU RASFF notification data that can be transformed into searchable risk intelligence
Fifteen identified market gaps despite six known competitors
High SEO accessibility, with 84% of supplied keyword opportunities classified as easy difficulty
risk_factors: The validated beachhead demand is only 74,000 searches per month, below the 100,000-search STRIVE Searchable threshold
The in-scope pain set represents only 8 of 21 niche pains, limiting the initial serviceable market
Average willingness-to-pay is low at 0.37, and the supplied pricing model is primarily advertising- and affiliate-supported
Free tools and established products coexist with paid products, creating monetization and differentiation pressure
FDA and RASFF data interpretation, freshness, completeness, and regulatory context may create accuracy and liability risks
viability_rationale: Moderate viability: the market has 91 pain-point mentions (Talked About), 6 competitors (Rivalry), and clear entry channels through SEO, specialty coffee communities, roaster associations, importer partnerships, and compliance-oriented content (Enterable). Searchable is not met because the 74K beachhead is below 100K monthly searches, Income Potential is not met because the beachhead SAM is approximately $0.08-$0.17M rather than above $50M, and Velocity is not scoreable because historical trend data is unavailable; therefore, 3 of 5 scoreable STRIVE criteria are met. The estimate satisfies the hierarchy: TAM is approximately 5.4x-24.6x SAM, SAM is at least 2x Year 1 SOM, and Year 3 SOM remains below SAM.
